profiles.description: Mapping of profile names to profile configurations

user.description: Mainframe (z/OSMF) user name, which can be the same as your TSO login.

password.description: Mainframe (z/OSMF) password, which can be the same as your TSO password.

certFile.description: The file path to a certificate file to use for authentication

certKeyFile.description: The file path to a certificate key file to use for authentication

basePath.description: The base path for your API mediation layer instance. Specify this option to prepend the base path to all z/OSMF resources when making REST requests. Do not specify this option if you are not using an API mediation layer.

encoding.description: The encoding for download and upload of z/OS data set and USS files. The default encoding if not specified is IBM-1047.

responseTimeout.description: The maximum amount of time in seconds the z/OSMF Files TSO servlet should run before returning a response. Any request exceeding this amount of time will be terminated and return an error. Allowed values: 5 - 600

characterSet.description: Character set for address space to convert messages and responses from UTF-8 to EBCDIC.

codePage.description: Codepage value for TSO/E address space to convert messages and responses from UTF-8 to EBCDIC.

columns.description: The number of columns on a screen.

logonProcedure.description: The logon procedure to use when creating TSO procedures on your behalf.

regionSize.description: Region size for the TSO/E address space.

rows.description: The number of rows on a screen.

host.description: The z/OS SSH server host name.

user.description: Mainframe user name, which can be the same as your TSO login.

password.description: Mainframe password, which can be the same as your TSO password.

privateKey.description: Path to a file containing your private key, that must match a public key stored in the server for authentication

keyPassphrase.description: Private key passphrase, which unlocks the private key.

handshakeTimeout.description: How long in milliseconds to wait for the SSH handshake to complete.

host.description: The hostname or IP address of the z/OS server to connect to.

port.description: The port of the z/OS FTP server.

secureFtp.description: Set to true for both control and data connection encryption, 'control' for control connection encryption only, or 'implicit' for implicitly encrypted control connection (this mode is deprecated in modern times, but usually uses port 990). Note: Unfortunately, this plugin's functionality only works with FTP and FTPS, not 'SFTP' which is FTP over SSH.

rejectUnauthorized.description: Reject self-signed certificates. Only specify this if you are connecting to a secure FTP instance.

servername.description: Server name for the SNI (Server Name Indication) TLS extension. Only specify if you are connecting securely

connectionTimeout.description: How long (in milliseconds) to wait for the control connection to be established.

encoding.description: The encoding for download and upload of z/OS data set.

properties.title: CICS Profile
properties.description: A cics profile is required to issue commands in the cics command group that interact with CICS regions. The cics profile contains your host, port, user name, and password for the IBM CICS management client interface (CMCI) server of your choice.

user.description: Your username to connect to CICS

password.description: Your password to connect to CICS

regionName.description: The name of the CICS region name to interact with

cicsPlex.description: The name of the CICSPlex to interact with

properties.title: IBM RSE API Zowe Profile
properties.description: A profile to issue commands to a z/OS system with a working Zowe REST server,Mediation Layer, or IBM RSE (Remote System Explorer) API server installation.

host.description: The z/OS host name running the Zowe REST API.

port.description: The server port used by the REST API.

user.description: The user name for the Zowe REST API operations.

password.description: The password of the user for the Zowe REST API operations.

basePath.description: The base path of the API for the REST API operations.

protocol.description: Only HTTPS supported for a TLS handshake to access REST API.

encoding.description: The encoding for download and upload of z/OS data set and USS files. The encoding should be specified in the form of "IBM-1047".

tokenType.description: JWT type assigned to profile when "zowe rse auth login" is used for authentication.

tokenValue.description: JWT value assigned to profile when "zowe rse auth login" is used for authentication.

tokenExpiration.description: JWT expiration assigned to profile when "zowe rse auth login" is used for authentication.

properties.title: Zowe Z Open Debug Profile
properties.description: Zowe Profile to use IBM z/OS Debugger

host.description: The z/OS host name you are running the debugger against.

dpsPort.description: The port that Debug Profile Service is running on.

dpsContextRoot.description: The context root for Debug Profile Service

dpsSecured.description: Is Debug Profile Service running securely?

rdsPort.description: The port that Remote Debug Service is running on. If the rdsPort is undefined, Z Open Debug will attempt to automatically discover it

rdsSecured.description: Is Remote Debug Service running securely?

uuid.description: unique id for profile. This value is generated programatically and should not be changed. Doing so may cause unexpected behaviour.

tokenValue.description: The token value used for multi factored authentication

authenticationType.description: How authentication is performed with Debug Profile Service. Supports either 'basic' or 'token' authentication.

properties.title: The endevor profile
properties.description: The endevor profile schema, where you specify your endevor session information and credentials

host.description: The hostname of the endevor session

port.description: The port number of the endevor session

user.description: The username of the endevor session

protocol.description: The protocol used for connecting to Endevor Rest API

basePath.description: The base path used for connecting to Endevor Rest API

rejectUnauthorized.description: If set, the server certificate is verified against the list of supplied CAs

reportDir.description: The default path where any reports will be written to, either absolute or relative to current directory

properties.title: The Endevor element inventory location specification profile
properties.description: The Endevor element location, where you specify your working environment, system and subsystem

environment.description: The Endevor environment where your project resides

system.description: The Endevor system where the element resides

subsystem.description: The Endevor subsystem where your element resides

type.description: Name of the Endevor element's type

stageNumber.description: The Endevor stage where your project resides

comment.description: The Endevor comment you want to use when performing an action

ccid.description: The Endevor CCID you want to use when performing an action

maxrc.description: The return code of Endevor that defines a failed action

override-signout.description: Always override element signout, without having to specify the override signout option on each command

file-extension.description:
The strategy for deciding what file extension to use during a bulk retrieve or workspace synchronization. Must be one of the following:

            none: File name is equal to element name, no extension is added.

            file-ext: The file extension defined in the Type definition is used; If not defined, no extension is added.

            type-name: The type name is used as the file extension.

            mixed: The file extension defined in Type definition is used; If not defined, the type name is used instead.

properties.title: Base Profile
properties.description: Base profile that stores values shared by multiple service profiles

host.description: Host name of service on the mainframe.

port.description: Port number of service on the mainframe.

user.description: User name to authenticate to service on the mainframe.

password.description: Password to authenticate to service on the mainframe.

tokenType.description: The type of token to get and use for the API. Omit this option to use the default token type, which is provided by 'zowe auth login'.

tokenValue.description: The value of the token to pass to the API.

certFile.description:
The file path to a certificate file to use for authentication.

Note: The CLI does not support certificate files that require a password. For more information, search Troubleshooting PEM Certificates in Zowe Docs.

certKeyFile.description: The file path to a certificate key file to use for authentication

defaults.description: Mapping of profile types to default profile names

autoStore.description: If true, values you enter when prompted are stored for future use
